title: Lifts we've installed: the installs showcase

scenes.narration: Lifts we've installed is a new showcase on the website. Each listing is a lift FiberSteel put in, with FiberSteel's photos, the lift size, the boat and the slip. The ones in this demo are samples.
Boaters can narrow it down by boat type, by lift size, or by how the boat docks.
Each install has its photos, what was built for the boat, and a quote button for a lift like it.
The same installs show on each lift page, so the listings sell the lift and the custom work at the same time.
A few featured ones show on the FiberSteel home page too.
New installs are added over time, from the photos FiberSteel sends of finished jobs. Each one shows the town, never the address.
And if FiberSteel would rather wait until it has photos it's proud of, the showcase can stay off until then. The lift pages simply skip it, and Our installs leaves the menu.
Switched back on, it's all there again.
